title: Chapter 702
paragraphs: Chapter 702
Episode 179. Unavoidable Trap (1)
Including the first-class butler Petro, the butlers and stewards of Runcandel, about thirty native Kollon, and Vin Branche, a contractor of Picon Minche.
The knights led by Mary successfully infiltrated Huphester and rescued about a hundred survivors.
"...We confirmed that our allies, who we originally thought were in the territory of Big Brother, had fled to the west of Delki, and there was no problem until we infiltrated there again."

"We were constantly attacked by knights and monsters tainted by chaos, but we were lucky enough. The butlers who were left in the territory informed us of the situation before we even began to search seriously, and Mother... No, Rosa, of course, and strong enemies like the Knights of the Tomb did not appear."
Daitona and Heitona said. The two, along with Jin, were sitting in front of the recovery room where Yona and Mary were, looking uncomfortable.

"Even after arriving in Delki, things went smoothly. An unexpected person, Prince Lyca, was hiding the survivors well. But while escaping to the sea where Cosmos' spaceship was waiting, after receiving the rescued targets... I saw Brother Diphus..."
Diphus Runcandel.
The one who attacked Mary and the knights at the end was completely consumed by chaos. He had horns growing on his head, like Rosa.
-Huh. What will happen to Diphus brother and the knights now?

-They will all be imprisoned in the underground dungeon. The fourth generation... Rosa has been desiring them from the beginning. They have a high probability of becoming Rosa's people. Because of chaos.
The story Mary heard from Lin Milcano turned out to be true.

"As soon as my second brother appeared, we thought the operation was bound to fail. Just releasing his energy was enough to shake the fleet of Cosmos. Even if all of us stood against him, it seemed we couldn't handle him."
As soon as Mary saw Diphus, she approached him like a person who had lost her soul.
-Brother... Is it you? Brother Diphus. It's me, Mary. Don't you remember me?
-Lady Mary, you can't go! Stop!
Mary didn't seem to have any intention of fighting Diphus, who had changed.
Diphus also did not swing his sword at Mary.
Rather, he smiled contentedly and waited slowly for Mary to approach.
-[Yes, Mary. The place you should be is not Tikan, but by my side. Come on, I'll help you. As always.]
Diphus even greeted Mary by saying that.
But fortunately.
Mary did not lose her sanity when she saw Diphus.

"Sister Mary immediately realized that there was no answer to directly confront Brother Diphus, and she showed her wit. If Sister had not pretended to break down at that time, we all could not have returned......"
Diphus had not forgotten his past relationship with Mary.
That's why her actions looked reasonable to him.
In other words, he let his guard down.
As soon as Mary got close to Diphus, she calmly unfolded her lightspeed stabbing, and she entered the battle by opening the volcano.
Diphus lost half of his body as soon as the fight started.
Mary used her swordsmanship more ruthlessly than ever, and then the Tona brothers and the knights realized her intentions and hurried to prepare for their escape.
The battle did not last long.
The soul energy quickly recovered more than half of Diphus's lost body. Intuitively, Mary was convinced that the moment he fully recovered, there would be no next time.
So she put all her effort into escaping to the fleet while Diphus was recovering, and it was inevitable to take a few of Diphus's attacks just before arriving.
That's why Mary is in the healing room now.
"...I'm so worried about you, youngest one."
It was not the wounds on her body she was talking about.
Her heart.
Although Mary's wit to push Diphus back for a while was definitely a performance, her painful heart could not be fake.

'Was Yuria's condition bad because of Brother Diphus? Since there were a lot of Mary's belongings in Tikan, the Authority of Truth may have made her sense this unfavorable future from him. I don't know what to say to Sister Mary...'
As Jin silently comforted his brothers, there was a stir from within the healing room.
"Worried? I'm more worried about you guys who just sit and get comforted from Jin, you Tona bastards."
"Sister Mary!"
"Sister, are you awake......!"
The Tona brothers, who quickly stood up to check on Mary, had red eyes.
Mary clicked her tongue at their sight.

"I've been awake for a while. I just wanted to rest a bit while hugging Yona because I was so tired, but I kept hearing voices. I came out because it seemed like it was my duty to run away if you two idiots even shed a tear."
"We're sorry, Sister."
"But we didn't cry. Of course, if you hit us, we'll take it sweetly."

"It's shameful, you pathetic fools. Jin is your younger brother. I understand if your strength or skills are lower than his. But at least try to act a bit more like older brothers mentally. How long are you going to depend on Jin? I'm telling you to be a bit more reliable."
After blasting the Tona brothers, Mary met eyes with Jin.
"Don't make that pooped face either. If the boss shows signs of worry and concern, it tends to make the subordinates more frustrated."
"Yes, Sister. I will keep that in mind."
"It's not that we couldn't save the people, and that Brother Diphus ended up like this...... It's unfortunate, but it's not an unforeseen problem."
Anyone who knew the relationship between Diphus and Mary would know.
That Mary is currently forcing herself to act okay.
Jin admired Mary.
Her vow to never show weakness again, and to never lose her composure even if the day comes when she faces Diphus engulfed in chaos.
Since coming to Tikan, she has kept all her words.
Giving clumsy comfort to Mary would rather be an insult.
"So what we need to worry about now is the safety of the remaining survivors and Brother Diphus's intentions."
"Sister, if it's Brother Diphus's intentions......?"
"No matter how I think about it, Brother Diphus deliberately let us go. The ships of Cosmos are great, but if Brother Diphus had pursued us with all his might, he could have easily caught us."
"Huh, Sister. Then did Brother Diphus regain his senses for a moment at that time?"
"Do you think so? Hey, Tona. We should completely exclude such assumptions in the first place. Brother is no longer the person we knew. He's crossed a river of no return."
Excluding even a word of hope about Diphus is no different for Mary.
She was certain that the moment she harbored hope for Diphus, Rosa would certainly use it in some way.
Or even the fallen Diphus himself would use it.
The best choice she could make for Diphus was to end Rosa and the Garden of Swords as soon as possible.
Even if that meant she had to cut down Diphus in the process.
"Anyway, I've been thinking about why on earth Brother let us go while I was lying down. Somehow...... I have a feeling it was due to despair."
Valeria recorded the information that her colleagues found out while Mary was absent in a notebook and left it in her healing room, and Mary looked over all of it.

"Is it also presumed that Rosa uses Joshua to generate despair? The same may be true for Brother Diphus. However, unlike Joshua... he's not falling into despair himself, but rather, he's playing the role of intensifying the despair of others."

"So you're saying that Brother Diphus thought it would be more effective to form despair by letting us go once from Delki and then catching us again rather than slaughtering you and the rescue targets there?"

"That's right, because failure after success always hurts more. Or maybe the despair we get from killing us at Delki wouldn't have been satisfying enough. As I just said, Brother didn't find his sanity in the chaos because of me. He definitely didn't just let us go on a whim. There must be a reason, and it certainly has to do with the completion of Rosa."
Completing Rosa is purely a matter of time and despair.
Jin felt that Mary's intuition was likely correct.
"Then Brother Diphus will lure us again."
When a hunter releases his prey, it's usually to use it as bait to lure bigger prey.
"Yeah, that's probably it. Either prepare well or we should strike first... it's hard to decide. There are too many ways Brother could choose to prepare, and moving first is too risky."
"I will also inform Kinzelo and Zipple about Brother Diphus. Since Orgal is currently looking for Joshua, we should also check Diphus' location during this process."
Diphus was the same as Joshua.
Unless found and completely removed, Rosa will continue to generate despair through them.
However, unlike Joshua, Diphus' death can only lead to Jin and Mary's despair.
Even so, Mary believes that removing Diphus is the only thing for him, but Jin wanted to find another way.
'Maybe Rosa is hoping we will kill Brother Diphus. Plus, since Brother has physical modifications, it's impossible to treat him with the current purification device.'
The best thing would be to suppress Diphus and seal him until a means of purification can be found. Like how they left Luntia in the void for now.
At that moment of thought, Jin saw Kashimir and Jet approaching from the other side.
Kashimir had just received a report from Jet and came to find Jin.
"Knight Kashimir."
"Lord Jin, we just got bad news from Zipple."
"Don't tell me they're suggesting breaking the temporary alliance?"
"No, on the contrary, they've requested support as part of the temporary alliance. The Lutero Magic Federation has been attacked, and the attacker is... said to be Sir Diphus."
Jin, Mary, and the Tona brothers instinctively gritted their teeth.
Diphus had already started to move.
